After breakfast, set out on horseback. The ride takes you along narrow trails and across the open plains of the Pantanal, where you can get close to the surrounding wildlife. Tall grasses move in the wind, birds call nearby, and you may spot animals in the vegetation. Local guides accompany you and point out details that are easy to miss at a faster pace.

The horses’ calm temperament and the guides’ experience make this an accessible way to explore the Pantanal. You can take your time, stopping to watch what happens in the grass and at the water’s edge.

After the ride, return to the lodge for lunch and a rest.

In the afternoon, head out on a 4x4 photo safari. The route passes through marshes and grasslands and alongside pools and waterways. The light towards sunset is well suited to watching and photographing wildlife, and the water reflects the sky and surrounding vegetation.

The Pantanal is home to capybaras, caimans, herons, storks, kingfishers and many other birds. You can often spot capybaras near the water, caimans on the banks and birds flying over open ground and water. With luck, you may see a jaguar or a giant otter. Photographers may find the softer light especially rewarding, as reflections and long shadows change the look of the landscape. Your guides explain how the animals behave and how the Pantanal ecosystem works as you observe it on the safari.

Return to the hotel for dinner after the outing.

Seven Waterfalls and Transfer to Bonito

Leave early in the morning for Bonito. On the way, take a walking trail to seven waterfalls on the Mimosa River.

The trail leads through the forest to the Mimosa River. You’ll see seven waterfalls of different heights and shapes, and at selected stops you can swim beneath the falls or in natural pools. The walk alternates between stretches of forest trail and stops by the water. Along the way you’ll pass small caves, wooden suspension footbridges and a viewpoint. There’s also a six-metre platform for anyone who wants to jump into the water.

After the walk, lunch is served in the main building. You can then relax in a hammock before continuing by transfer to your hotel in Bonito.

Bonito is one of Brazil’s best-known ecotourism destinations. Ancient forests sit alongside caves with stalactites and stalagmites, waterfalls and clear rivers where you can easily see tropical fish.
